status: Concept redesign integrated into the ZL80 scanner; calculation and nominal envelope only; not manufacturing release
supersedes: ADF50-V0.3 (straight in-plane, 995 mm deep, does not fit the bench), V0.2 (path leaves the magazine outward and folds back, rejected) and V0.1; all three folders kept unchanged

user_constraints_2026_11_16.rule: bends are allowed if reasonable; the film must not travel outward first and then fold back

architecture: one-way flow: inclined gravity magazine in front (film slides down toward the scanner through one large-radius bend), horizontal scan plane, upward ramp bend into a standing output bin behind the scanner

reference_options.option: A V0.1 外置，片仓80°，整张缓冲
B V0.2 片仓折回扫描仪上方
C 整机倾斜60°直通（粗估）
reference_options.core_change: 光学核心整体旋转，机架机箱重做

assumptions: Media: developed, fixed, fully dried sheet film, one thickness class per batch, no interleaving paper.
Friction coefficients, modulus, adhesion and all forces are design assumptions, not measurements.
Coordinates are the R5-PDR1 nominal frame (scan line Y=0, film plane Z=110, enclosure 320x300x300, film travels toward +Y) with the R5.2 collector layout B.
Scan modes come from the R5.2 photon budget; calculated, not measured.
Dam model is a cantilever estimate, feed/retard window a rigid friction estimate, bend reaction an order-of-magnitude estimate (4*EI/R^2). All need a mock-up with real film.
